body:
alex.m: Hey infra — launching a greenfield inference project (internal code JCE-21). Need GPU quota added to project `prod-juice-21` (project number 123456789012). Request: L4 (NVIDIA L4) x32, H100 x8 (spot/preemptible OK), fallback A100 x8. Preferred region: us-west1, fallback us-west2. Also need higher external IP quota (+50) and increase of inter-region egress to 10 TB/month. Need this within ~5 business days if possible. Any fast path?

nina.infra: Can you paste the GCP project number (you did) and the billing account? Also please fill the quota request form so we have the business justification for approvals.

alex.m: billing account is `billing-9876-juice`. Quick justification: onboarding a paying customer and running scaled perf tests. I'll attach a short justification doc after this thread.

nina.infra: Cool. Two quick checks to run and paste here: `gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --project=prod-juice-21` and `gcloud compute project-info describe --project=prod-juice-21` so we confirm current quotas and usages. If you want I can run them.

alex.m: If you can run, please — I'm in the middle of a meeting.

gcp-quota-bot: Ticket created: Q-6784. Please include business justification and "time-sensitive" if <7 days. Link: https://internal-ops.example.com/q/Q-6784 (auto message).

maria.pm: Adding context — this is for the new customer pilot (1 production service + staging). Need predictable latency; team will use spot H100 for cost during training and keep a small reserved pool if H100 availability is low. Budget approved under JCE-21.

sre_oncall: Heads up: H100 spot pools in us-west1 are tight right now. If quota approved but capacity not available, need fallback plan: either use A100 or split across us-west1 + us-west2. Also ensure nodePool autoscaling policy uses `maxSurge:1` and proper PDBs to avoid evictions impacting the service.

cloud-ops: Here's a minimal request payload I will submit on your behalf; please make sure the justification string matches the billing/legal doc. Use this snippet in the form:```json
{
  "project_id": "prod-juice-21",
  "project_number": "123456789012",
  "billing_account": "billing-9876-juice",
  "quotas": [
    {"metric": "GPUS_NVIDIA_L4", "region": "us-west1", "limit": "32"},
    {"metric": "GPUS_NVIDIA_H100", "region": "us-west1", "limit": "8", "preemptible": true},
    {"metric": "GPUS_NVIDIA_A100", "region": "us-west1", "limit": "8", "note": "fallback"},
    {"metric": "EXTERNAL_IP_ADDRESSES", "region": "global", "limit": "+50"},
    {"metric": "NETWORK_EGRESS_TB", "region": "multi", "limit": "10"}
  ],
  "justification": "Customer pilot and perf validation for inference workload (JCE-21). Time sensitive: 5 business days."
}
```

nina.infra: Thanks. Two bits: 1) we need the org approver (security/business) to sign off for H100 due to high-cost GPU — who is that on your side? 2) We'll need the invoice cost center code.

alex.m: Org approver is `maria.pm`. Cost center: CC-44-JCE. I'll upload the justification PDF to the ticket now.

gcp-quota-bot: Q-6784 status updated: "Submitted to GCP Support". Estimated turnaround: L4 ~72 hours, H100 may be 5-10 business days depending on capacity.

maria.pm: Approved the justification and signed off for org-level. Marked as time-sensitive in procurement. :white_check_mark:

sre_oncall: Also recommend setting up node pool with `preemptible: true` for spot workloads and a small non-preemptible pool for critical shards. Add a K8s pod disruption budget and a retry/backoff strategy in the client to survive evictions.

alex.m: Re: naming — if we request "preemptible" in the quota form does GCP interpret that differently? I thought "spot" was the newer name.

cloud-ops: GCP uses "Spot" in the console but in some quota flows you can annotate `preemptible: true` or add a note. We'll mark both.

nina.infra: I've attached the payload, justification, and org approver signature to Q-6784 and flagged for expedited review. I'll follow up if they ask for architecture/network diagrams. Expect updates here.

alex.m: Awesome — thanks everyone. Please tag me on the ticket when a partial approval arrives (e.g., L4 approved first).

gcp-quota-bot: Q-6784 comment: "Partial approval: L4 quotas granted for us-west1 (32). H100 pending capacity review."

nina.infra: L4 is green. I'll keep pushing on H100 and the external IPs. If H100 takes too long, we'll request A100 in parallel to avoid blocking.

maria.pm: Also confirm budget alert thresholds once we start spinning GPUs — want a slack alert at 50% of expected burn.

cloud-ops: I'll add a billing alert and a cost dashboard for JCE-21.

nina.infra: Submitted follow-up for EXTERNAL_IP + NETWORK_EGRESS increases. Should be reviewed in 24-48 hrs.

alex.m: Great. Tagging infra oncall if anything breaks during early tests: @sre_oncall.

sre_oncall: Will monitor. If we see preemptions spike, we'll spawn extra small CPU nodes to take burst traffic.

nina.infra: Closing the loop for now — L4 approved and partial ticket updates posted. I'll update last status here when H100 or external IPs are resolved. :rocket:
